falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern failed to hold support; a breakdown below the August 2024 lows invalidates the structural bottom thesis and confirms continuation lower, not accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Volatility regime has shifted to crisis-level sustained fear, breaking the post-August 2024 pattern where VIX spikes above 30 were brief and quickly mean-reverted; this signals capitulation not bottoming

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts further below -50bps (more negative) and stays there for 3+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion with persistence indicates recession probability spiking and credit conditions tightening, contradicting the soft-landing/recovery narrative embedded in the bottom_2024_aug pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
